task: human validation of the image-reconstructed forms gold
gold_corrected_by: Claude Opus (large multimodal model, not among the evaluated engines)

sample.selection: reproducible uniform random sample over scored fields

result.agreement: full; both annotators independently marked every sampled field correct

notes: Two annotators reviewed the same random sample independently, against the form images, in the browser tool (scripts/validation/gen_review_html.py; see docs/img/human_validation.png). One discussed non-error: checkbox answers are not encoded uniformly across forms. A checked item is sometimes transcribed as the mark it carries (e.g. one consent form's seven checklist items, each a 'V'); the consensus was that the reconstructed value is correct, while the same answer could equally be encoded another way (the marked option, or an 'x'). This is a representation choice from the gold-correction prompt, not a wrong value. The raw per-field annotations and the field values are not redistributed here: the underlying forms gold derives from XFUND (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and is fetched from source; this file records only PII-free counts.
